title: Dr. Carvalho's 35 Colares patients, interviewed by Jacques Vallee

tellings.quote: spoke to Dr. Carvalo who saw 35 patients who all had the same sunburns and puncture wounds and the two women that died of a stroke

plain: In 1977, in the Brazilian village of Colares, a local doctor named Dr. Carvalho treated 35 patients who all had the same sunburns and puncture wounds, and two women died of a stroke, after reports of lights in the sky attacking people. Michels tells this from a book called Forbidden Science, saying the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée went to Brazil and spoke to the doctor himself. If true, it would mean the strange lights physically harmed people.
